## What's new

- Updates at start: Zenith Trade checks for a new version each time it starts, and puts it in place at once, starting again by itself.
- A mod cut short shows its whole text in place while the pointer is on it, wrapped over the rows under it.
- A mod over several lines has one bar down all its lines, in the mod's own colour (Foulborn, enchant, influence...), and its mark in their middle.
- A unique's mod that does not roll (a Foulborn mod, for one) is searched as it is, without a number to fill in.
- A Greater viscera is searched as its plain base: the trade site does not know the word.
- A cluster jewel searched as a base keeps its enchants: how many passives, and what the small ones grant.

## Install

Download `Zenith-win-Setup.exe` below and run it. It installs for your user only (no admin rights), adds a Start menu entry and starts Zenith Trade in the system tray. An installed copy updates itself when it starts.

Windows SmartScreen may warn that the publisher is unknown, because the installer is not signed: click "More info", then "Run anyway".
